subject: general
question: Which of the following home appliances does NOT use an electric motor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electric iron**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **An electric motor** is an electronic machine that **converts an electric signal into mechanical signals**.
 
• Electric motors **produce force** **in the form of torque** that is applied to the motor shaft through the interaction of the magnetic field of the motor and electric current in a wire winding.
 
• **Electric iron **works on the **heating effect of electric current** and not an electric motor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Electric fans, Electric mixers, and Electric washing machines use an **electric motor** to convert **electric energy** to mechanical energy such as rotation of fan blades, churning property of mixer blades, and washing of clothes respectively.
